title: Slovak Stir Fry with Tofu
description: A quick and easy Slovak-inspired dish made with crispy tofu and a variety of stir-fried vegetables. Serve hot over rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove tofu from skillet and set aside.
Add garlic, onion, and bell pepper to skillet and cook until vegetables are tender.
Add carrots and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Return tofu to skillet and stir in paprika and soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until tofu is coated in sauce.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
